title: Yakshi: why you never stop under a pala tree at night
planner: Claude Opus 5.5 (Fable at its limit), 27 Oct 2026

facts.claim: In Kerala folklore the Yakshi is a female spirit in a white sari with long hair
She is associated with the pala tree (Alstonia scholaris), whose strongly scented flowers bloom in the evening
facts.source: Aithihyamala; botanical references on Alstonia scholaris

facts.claim: In the stories she asks passers-by for chunnambu (lime for betel)
Kalliyankattu Neeli is the most famous Yakshi legend
Legend says the priest Kadamattathu Kathanar subdued her with a nail

opening.why: Story/object hook; location isn't the surprise.

hook_en: You were told never to stop under a pala tree at night. Here's why.

headline: DON'T STOP
UNDER THE PALA
cover.hook_voiceover_ml: രാത്രി. ഒരു പാലമരം. പൂവിന്റെ മണം. അവിടെ നിൽക്കരുതെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞത് എന്തിനാണെന്നറിയാമോ?
cover.visual: Moonlit path, a huge pala tree with glowing white flower clusters; a faint white figure appears behind the trunk
cover.build_cmd: SK.sky(g,'night',0.62); big moon (SK.sun with col '#f4f0e0', glow 0.35) at x0.75,y0.18. Ground and a pale path curving to the horizon. Pala tree at x0.42: thick dark trunk from y0.66 to y0.36, canopy of 8 overlapping dark ellipses, 40 small white flower clusters that twinkle. Scent wisps (thin translucent curves) drift right. From 60% a pale white figure (tall narrow shape, long dark hair, 0→0.55 opacity) fades in half-hidden behind the trunk.

scenes.voiceover_ml: യക്ഷി. നമ്മുടെ നാട്ടിലെ ഏറ്റവും പേടിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥ. വെള്ള സാരി, നീണ്ട മുടി.
scenes.headline: KERALA'S OWN GHOST
scenes.visual: A ghostly white figure with flowing hair on the moonlit path
scenes.build_cmd: Night scene. A semi-transparent white figure (sari as a tapered white shape, long black hair that waves with t) at x0.5,y0.62, opacity breathing 0.5–0.8. Fireflies drift. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: അവളുടെ താവളം പാലമരം എന്നാണ് വിശ്വാസം. രാത്രി പൂക്കുന്ന പാലപ്പൂവിന്റെ മണം അടയാളം.
scenes.headline: THE PALA TREE
scenes.visual: Close-up of the canopy, flowers opening, scent particles rising
scenes.build_cmd: Close-up canopy filling the middle band: dark leaves, 30 white star-shaped flowers that open (scale 0→1) one after another; tiny glowing particles rise and drift (the scent). Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: ഏറ്റവും പേരുകേട്ടവൾ കള്ളിയങ്കാട്ട് നീലി. ഐതിഹ്യമാലയിലെ കഥ.
scenes.headline: KALLIYANKATTU NEELI
scenes.build_cmd: SK.stage(g,t). On the screen: SK.puppet at x0.62 (the Yakshi, armUp false) and a small house silhouette at x0.3. At 50% the puppet glides 80 px left. Title card rendered by the overlay only. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: കടമറ്റത്ത് കത്തനാർ അവളെ ഒരു ആണി കൊണ്ട് തളച്ചെന്നാണ് കഥ.
scenes.headline: TAMED WITH A NAIL
scenes.visual: On the stage, a priest figure raises a glowing nail
scenes.build_cmd: SK.stage(g,t). Two puppets: priest (x0.35, armUp true) and Yakshi (x0.65, armUp false). A glowing nail (thin white rect with a bright tip) appears in the priest's raised hand at 40%; at 70% a burst of light rays (SK.rays) from the nail; the Yakshi puppet dims to 0.3. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: ഇനി രാത്രി പാലപ്പൂ മണക്കുമ്പോൾ, ആരെങ്കിലും ചുണ്ണാമ്പ് ചോദിച്ചാൽ... തിരിഞ്ഞു നോക്കരുത്!
scenes.headline: DON'T LOOK BACK
scenes.visual: A walker on the night road; behind, a faint white figure
scenes.build_cmd: Night road under the moon. A SK.person walks away from the camera towards the horizon (shrinking 1→0.6). Far behind (x0.2) the faint white figure appears at 50% and follows, opacity 0.4. The walker never turns. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).
